What is 24K Pure Gold Facial?

The ultimate luxurious anti-aging treatment that uses pure gold massaged into your skin to brighten and energize complexion. Historical evidence dating back to 2500 B.C. suggests various cultures embraced gold for its beauty and wellness properties, with stories such as Cleopatra adorning herself nightly with a pure gold mask in pursuit of flawless skin. Elements 24K Pure Gold Facial massages real gold into your skin, ensuring maximum absorption of its benefits. Followed by an ultrasound infusion of our 24K Gold Serum enriched with gold flakes, lotus flower, and rose extract. This facial is designed to revive radiance, fortify the skin’s natural barrier, and enhance collagen production, thus diminishing wrinkles and fine lines for a rejuvenated visage. It is no surprise that this facial earned the prestigious title of “Best Luxurious Facial” at the 2023 Harpers Bazaar Spa Awards.

blocks.text: What are the benefits of 24K gold Mask
blocks.html: What are the benefits of 24K gold Mask

Anti-Aging Properties
Gold masks are often promoted for their supposed ability to stimulate collagen production, improve skin elasticity, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Gold particles may help enhance skin firmness and promote a youthful complexion.

Enhanced Radiance
It have revitalising properties that can help brighten dull skin, restore radiance, and even out skin tone. They may help minimize the appearance of age spots, sun damage, and other forms of hyperpigmentation.

Hydrating & Moisturising
Contains hydrating ingredients which can help attract and retain moisture in the skin. This can result in a plump, dewy complexion and improved overall skin texture.

Anti-Inflammatory
Help soothe irritated skin, reduce redness, and calm inflammation associated with conditions like acne, rosacea, or sensitive skin.

Luxurious Experience
Beyond their potential skincare benefits, gold masks offer a luxurious pampering experience. The application of a gold mask can feel indulgent and spa-like, providing a moment of relaxation and self-care.

How 24K Pure Gold Facial Works

• Covers your face with pure 24k gold.
  • Gold boosts collagen production and reduces inflammation for healthy cell renewal that results in youthful skin. Gold also slows down the depletion of collagen level in your skin cells, helping to maintain firm and lifted skin.
  • Pure gold is known to slow down collagen depletion and the breakdown of elastin, to prevent sagging skin.
  • The ions present in gold improve blood circulation, cells metabolism and detoxification for radiant skin.
  • Gold helps stimulate cellular growth in the deepest layer of the skin to regenerate healthy, firm skin cells.
  • Gold’s anti-inflammatory properties are thought to slow down melanin secretion, helping to reduce pigmentation and brighten skin.
